trips.note: Winnipeg Limited. St. Paul 8.02 p.m. to Winnipeg 9.00 a.m. Connects at St. Paul with the New Empire Builder from Chicago (1.00 p.m.). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.
